title: The Quantum Unique Ergodicity Conjecture
exact_target: Must every high-energy eigenfunction sequence on a compact negatively curved manifold become uniformly distributed?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004023 (OWR-16636-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Free Probability Theory (2018), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2018/53, pp. 3147--3215. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 55.
Lindenstrauss (2006) (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Soundararajan (2010) (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The supplied sentence asks equidistribution of all eigenfunctions, without discarding an exceptional subsequence. The displayed spatial criterion explains that wording; the microlocal version is identified separately and not silently treated as the same weaker target.
